verdicts.reason: HOL4 defines `dest_Refv` via `Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition` (`new_specification`), saving only `dest_Refv (Refv v) = v`, which leaves `W8array`, `Varray`, and `Thunk` independent. Lean returns the same `ARB` for every non-`Refv` constructor, so it proves `dest_Refv (.W8array [] : store_v Nat) = dest_Refv (.Varray [] : store_v Nat)`, an equation left open by HOL4.

HOL4 defines `FV_dec` via `Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition` (`new_specification`), saving only the five equations for `Dlet`, `Dletrec`, `Dtype`, `Dtabbrev`, and `Dexn`, and none for `Dmod`, `Dlocal`, or `Denv`. Lean returns the same `ARB` set for all three omitted constructors, so it proves `FV_dec (.Dmod m []) = FV_dec (.Dlocal [] [])`, an equation left open by HOL4.
